reserveReview.rationale: Chronicle's daily independently verified holdings table identifies all 18 positions at its 2026-08-27T06:16:23Z source timestamp: five tri-party repo positions totaling $2.1355 billion and thirteen U.S. Treasury bills totaling $644.290777 million. The six curated slices preserve each repo counterparty and aggregate only the same-obligor Treasury bills; percentages are derived from the reported $2,779,790,777 aggregate portfolio market value. The current feed displays 2026-08-26 for every repo maturity despite the next-day source timestamp, so no new repo term is inferred from that anomaly. The latest stated Treasury-bill maturity is 2026-11-12, 77 days after the composition date.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer-authored Arbitrum STEP application (2024-05-04) states BNY Mellon is the Fund's administrator and custodian and that the Fund's assets are held in one or more accounts in the name of the Fund, with subcustodians and depositories permitted; no other fund-level custodian is named in reviewed sources, so the documented custody is a single-provider concentration. rwa.xyz (2026-07-16) lists the account segregation as bankruptcy remote. Sub-custodian splits and rehypothecation restrictions are not stated in reviewed public sources.
